messages:
eval-bot: nightly-evals detected a spike in "embedded source" fabrications on summarization suite. 45 failures vs baseline 2. details: https://internal.redwood/evals/1919007777 :alarm:

emma: ugh, can someone paste an example? is this the citation hallucination we saw last month?

raj: here's one from the failing case (trimmed input + output). model = rdlm-mini-quant8-nightly, prompt = long doc summarization:

```
INPUT: long article about urban planning (7k tokens)
OUTPUT: "The report (see Source: https://urban-research.example/2024/transport-study) concludes..."
Note: the URL is entirely fabricated, domain looks plausible.
```

sophia: interesting — I see two patterns: (1) full-looking URL snippets inserted mid-sentence, (2) bracketed citation markers like "[Ref: Sec. 4 of gov-report-2022]" that don't match any source in the doc. both happen only on quant builds.

liam: I ran a quick diff between float32 nightly and the int8 run. float32 output: no citations. quant8 output: spurious anchors. suspect kernel reorder or detokenizer mapping mismatch that turns some control tokens into printable chars.

maria: repro steps i used (local):
```
# repro
python -m redwood.eval_runner --model rdlm-mini-quant8-nightly --suite summarization_long --seed 42 --limit 10
# logs:
[2026-03-19T08:12:02Z] token_stream: ... 0x2c -> "http" 0x3f -> "://" ...
```
repro rate ~7/10 on my host (single GPU).

emma: @raj can you check whether this correlates with the kernel commit from yesterday (kv-merge + detok-fix)? commit id: ab12c3f (maybe).

raj: looking now. the detok mapping change (ab12c3f) adjusted unicode-range merges. i can revert locally and run the same eval. giving it a try.

raj: quick results: revert of ab12c3f -> quant8 run drops fabrications to 1/10. so probable cause = detok mapping regression interacting with quantized vocab indices.

sophia: could also be that quantized Embedding -> LM head alignment off by 1 for some vocab slice; that would shift token ids into printable punctuation/URL tokens. check embedding indices used at compile time.

liam: i'll instrument token id outputs (pre-detok) and compare sequences between float and quant for the failing sample. if we see off-by-one or shifted spans that's a smoking gun.

maria: created a short reproduce gist and uploaded logs to the triage folder: https://internal.redwood/triage/embedded-source-1919007777

emma: next steps: (1) raj to open internal regression ticket with revert patch and perf diff, (2) liam to produce token-id diffs and attach to ticket, (3) eng-ml oncall to hold rolling quant rollout until fix. tagging @raj @liam @sophia.

raj: ticket opened: INF-4321. assigning to eng-ml runtime. adding revert PR link. :thumbsup:

emma: nice triage. we should add a small eval that specifically checks for spurious URLs/citations as a guard. can someone add that to nightly suite?

sophia: i'll add a lightweight detector to summarization_long that flags tokens matching url-like patterns not present in source text. low cost. will PR today.

maria: i'll re-run full nightly after revert lands and report back in this thread.

eval-bot: update scheduled: INF-4321 created, CI rollback candidate queued. nightly will re-run at 2026-03-19T12:00:00Z.
